howToCall: activated:false: direct wrappers may be unavailable. Use tools:invoke {name:"<exact tool name from hits>", args:{...}}. This result includes `servingGeneration` for explicit callers that support it; do not pass it as a `tools:invoke` argument because legacy callable schemas may reject it. The MCP transport independently checks the `papercusp/servingGeneration` metadata attached to tools/list entries before dispatch. Exact names are prioritized; if `omittedTools` is present, query each listed name individually.
